quotes.author: Thomas Green
quotes.text: The best fishing charter in the region. We chartered the boat 4 days after a major storm hit the area--no charter company had caught a big fish since the storm. The Fintastic guys hooked us up with a 7'11" sailfish. My colleague has the mount in his office at work, but doesn't have a wall big enough, so the bill of the fish protrudes into the door space. I have to duck every time I walk into his office. You know you have a great trophy when you don't have a wall big enough to hang it!

quotes.author: Aubrey Hipolito
quotes.text: My family and I never gone fishing before. Captain Howard was great and helpful in the booking process. He also had many updates before the charter date to make sure we went on a day with good conditions. Captain Charlie and the first mate were both very nice and helpful. My family and I had so much fun! We caught 4 fish in 4 hours, and got to keep 2 of them. It was definitely a great experience!

quotes.author: Brooke skalet
quotes.text: I went to Miami with my family and we went out fishing on the Fintastic, me and my family had never been fishing before and Captain Charlie and Kai made it a wonderful experience for us. They were very knowledgeable and friendly. We caught more fish than we expected and I highly recommend this boat for anyone who wants to go charter fishing in Miami.

quotes.author: Jennifer Moon
quotes.text: We had a great time! The Captain and his mate were friendly and helpful. The atmosphere was very relaxing and we caught so many fish! Highly recommend Fintastic to anyone looking to have a great day on the water.

quotes.author: Sheryl Baker
quotes.text: Friendly and a fun crew. Loved my whole experience on board the fantastic. I’d recommend to anyone who wants to go and just relax and have fun.

quotes.author: Johnny Marseille
quotes.text: The most professional and kindest service I’ve experienced. These people are super on point.
